config: Same native GAT/SAGE config as the paired trainer; seeds exactly [7301,7403,7507]. Optional bootstrap_seed_offset must equal6000119. Root binds config/data/source/reference criteria before fitting.
weight_law: One local np.random.default_rng(family_seed+6000119) Exp(1) float64 [4,580] table per seed; class mean-one normalization preserves each native class mass; exact table shared across all three arms; no redraw/floor/clipping.
weight_artifacts: bootstrap_seed<seed>/WEIGHTS.npz preserves int64 TRAIN ids/y, float64 raw_exponential/weights. WEIGHTS.json binds archive/table/ordered-role hashes, generator/version, class diagnostics and setup seconds. The applied device tensor remains float64 and untrained.
gradient_law: shared native: partial mean ownCE; private r/s plus explicit Householder/LoRA banks: partial mean(weight*ownCE). Same four-route TRAIN forward, two torch.autograd.grad calls, one original AdamW step; generally nonconservative. Native shared loss law does not preserve the later shared trajectory.
reporting: Exact Parameter-identity roles/shapes/route axis; total and per-route own/weighted losses each update; both reverse-call counts and unconnected names; original traces/selection/restoration/raw logits/errors and measured costs. Weight setup costs separate from fit acquisition.
reused_references: All five original references plus completed coherent, paired_graph and rank1_lora_graph unweighted counterparts; no reference outcome is read by the acquisition source.
helpers_for_root_integration: bank_gradients(torch, F, logits, targets, weights, shared, private) returns own,weighted,unconnected,member_losses; attaches grads but never steps optimizer
